Description

The windscreen wash/wipe system is operated by a stalk switch on the right side of the steering wheel. The stalk switch can be set to five positions that correspond to different functions:

  • windscreen wiper off (standstill);
  • intermittent operation (or automatic operation if rain sensor fitted);
  • continuous slow operation;
  • continuous medium-fast operation;
  • temporary fast operation (unstable stalk position).

When the stalk switch is set to intermittent operation position, four different speeds can be selected by turning the relevant ring:

  • slow intermittent;
  • medium intermittent;
  • medium-fast intermittent;
  • fast intermittent.

if the rain sensor is fitted, the selection indicates mechanism intervention sensitivity.

The windscreen wiper function is operated by pulling the stalk switch slightly toward the steering wheel. This action operates the washer pump. If the stalk switch is held in position, the windscreen wiper also operates (continuous operation). The windscreen wiper carries on working for a few sweeps after the stalk switch is released.

The entire system is governed by an electronic device which is responsible for controlling the intermittent function and also the windscreen wiper motor and washer pump.

The windscreen wash/wipe circuit is protected by a specific fuse and is operated by the ignition-operated relay located in the junction unit.

The windscreen wiper and washer can be operated with the ignition key turned to MAR.

The system can also activate the windscreen wiper automatically if it rains by means of a special sensor positioned in contact with the windscreen on the rear view mirror.(for greater detail 5050 ).
